tldr: Consolidated revenue grew 11.8% YoY to INR 1,61,000 million, with EBITDA margins at 29.3%.
US business declined 8.2% YoY due to lenalidomide erosion, though QoQ growth was 6.5%.
India business remains a strong performer with 17.3% growth, driven by volume expansion and new product launches.
Organon acquisition remains on track for closure in Q4 FY27; integration planning is progressing as scheduled.
Ilumya growth slowed in the US; management has implemented interventions and expects recovery over the next few quarters.
management_commentary: Gross margin improved to 80.8% due to favorable product mix and currency tailwinds.
Ilumya received US approval for psoriatic arthritis; soft launch planned for November.
India business maintains #1 rank with 8.6% market share; volume growth of 6.7% significantly outperformed IPM growth of 1.8%.
R&D spend was 4.8% of sales (INR 7,784 million), with management expecting a ramp-up in H2 FY27.
Voluntary recall of 11 ophthalmic products from the Assam plant initiated to ensure quality and safety.
guidance: Maintain high single-digit top-line growth guidance for FY27.
R&D spend expected to ramp up in H2 FY27 to meet full-year guidance targets.
Organon acquisition on track to close by Q4 FY27.

segment_performance.notes: Revenue of INR 55,523 million, up 17.3% YoY; volume growth of 6.7% driven by strong prescription performance.
Revenue of USD 455 million, down 8.2% YoY due to lenalidomide erosion; 5 new generic products launched in Q2.
Sales up 6.9% to USD 356 million; growth impacted by US Ilumya slowdown, partially offset by international performance.
Revenue of USD 350 million, up 7.6% YoY; growth driven by branded generics and Ilumya.

key_metrics.context: Lower YoY due to Q2 FY26 lenalidomide benefit
Includes exceptional items for litigation and acquisition costs

notable_qa.question: What is driving the slowdown in US Ilumya growth and what is the recovery timeline?
notable_qa.answer: Management identified execution factors and market dynamics; interventions are in place, and the new psoriatic arthritis indication is expected to return the product to typical growth patterns over the next few quarters.

notable_qa.question: Is the 17% growth in India business sustainable and what is the volume vs. price mix?
notable_qa.answer: Growth is broad-based across 12 therapy areas; 50-60% of growth is driven by volume and new products, with the remainder from pricing.

notable_qa.question: Will the Organon acquisition involve further exceptional expenses in coming quarters?
notable_qa.answer: Yes, acquisition-related costs will continue until the transaction closes in Q4 FY27, with some costs being back-ended.

notable_qa.question: Can you comment on the media report regarding the Assam plant ophthalmic products?
notable_qa.answer: The company voluntarily recalled 11 products and initiated a temporary cessation of manufacturing to ensure quality and safety; the regulator has been kept informed.

risks: Execution risks in the US specialty business.
Regulatory and quality compliance risks (e.g., Assam plant recall).
Uncertainty in R&D clinical trial outcomes and timelines.
Integration risks associated with the Organon acquisition.
